title: One owner per truth.
hook: Every important thing in our system has exactly one owner. Here is why.
thesis: PING's authority model says every important concern has exactly one owner, and the rule that makes it real is that declared authority must match actual capability ownership. Comments do not establish authority, interfaces do not, enforcement does. The teachable version is a household analogy: one person owns the checkbook, and saying so out loud, with the power to back it up, is what makes it true.

verified: The authority model: one owner per concern; declared authority must match actual capability ownership (SOUL.md principles 6 and 8, via SYSTEMS.md section 1).
inferred: The household analogy accurately conveys the principle to a non-technical audience.

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
